Source: Among 420 participants, media exposure resulted in increased ability to identify KS (from 0.95% pretest to 46% posttest); awareness that anyone is at risk for KS (29% to 50%); belief that they may be at risk (63% to 76%); and knowledge that definitive diagnosis requires biopsy (23% to 51%) (all ).

Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí bèrè ìbéèrè lọ́wọ́ àwọn akópa kí wọ́n tó ṣí wọn lọ́yè nípa àkóónú àti lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n ṣi wọn lọ́yẹ̀, láti mọ̀ bóyá ìmọ̀ wọn àti ìṣesí wọn nípa KS ti gbòòrò si.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babuze ababambiqhaza imibuzo ngaphambi nangemuva kovuveza obala kokuqukethwe, ukuze bahlole ukuthi ulwazi lwabo nesimo sengqondo mayelana ne-KS sekuthuthukile yini.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi wa mahalarta tambayoyi kafin da kuma bayan bayyanar da abun ciki, don bincika ko iliminsu da halayensu game da cutar KS sun inganta.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba botšiša bakgathatema dipotšišo pele le ka morago ga ge ba bone melaetša ya temošo, go lekola ge eba tsebo ya bona le maikutlo a bona ka ga kankere ya KS a kaonafetše.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ስለ ካ.ሳ ያላቸው እውቀት እና አመለካከቶች እንደተሻሻሉ ለማረጋገጥ ይዘቱን ከመተዋወቃቸው በፊት እና በኋላ ተሳታፊዎቹን ጥያቄ ጠይቀዋል፡፡

Source: The researchers also collected information on age, sex, education, residence, income and HIV status.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baakuŋŋaanya obubaka obukwata ku myaka, ekikula, obuyigirize, obutuuze, ennyingiza n’obubaka bw’omuntu obukwata ku HIV.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí gba àlàyé lórí ọjọ́-orí wọn, ìṣakọṣabo, ipele ẹ̀kọ́, ibùgbé, owó, àti ipò HIV.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphinde baqoqa ulwazi ngeminyaka, ubulili, imfundo, indawo yokuhlala, imali engenayo kanye nesimo se-HIV.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma tattara bayanai a kan shekaru da jinsi da ilimi da wurin zama da samun kuɗin shiga da kuma matsayin HIV.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba kgoboketša gape tshedimošo ka ga mengwaga, bong, thuto, madulo, letseno le maemo ka ga HIV.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በተጨማሪ የእድሜ፣ የጾታ፣ የትምህርት፣ የመኖሪያ፣ የገቢ እና የኤችአይቪ ሁኔታ መረጃዎችን ሰብስበዋል፡፡

Source: They reported that before participants were exposed to the media, very few correctly identified KS wounds, believed everyone could develop KS, or felt they were at risk of KS.
Luganda: Baagamba nti abeetabi bwe baali tebannalaba butambi, batono nnyo abaali basobola okuzuula ebiwundu kya KS mu butuufu, okukkiriza nti buli omu yali asobola okufuna KS, oba abaawulira nti bali mu katyabaga ka KS.
Yoruba: Wọn jábọ̀ pé kí wọ́n tó la àwọn èèyàn lọ́yẹ̀ sí ẹ̀rọ oníròyìn, díẹ̀ nínú wọn ni ó lè ṣe ìdámọ̀ egbò KS, gbàgbọ́ pé gbogbo èèyàn ni ó lè ni KS, tàbí ní ìmọ̀lára pé wọ́n wà nínú ewu à ti kó KS.
Zulu: Babike ukuthi ngaphambi kokuba ababambiqhaza bavezwe kwabemithombo yabezindaba, bambalwa kakhulu abahlonze kahle amanxeba e-KS, bakholelwa ukuthi wonke umuntu angaba ne-KS, noma abe nomuzwa wokuthi basengozini ye-KS.
Hausa: Sun bayar da rahoton cewa kafin a bayyanawa mahalarta midiya ɗin, kaɗan ne kawai aka gano raunukan KS, sun yi imanin kowa zai iya haɓaka KS, ko kuma suna jin suna cikin haɗarin KS.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba bega gore pele ga ge bakgathatema ba fihlelela kgašo, ba bannyane kudu ba ile ba hlatha dintho tša kankere ya KS, ba dumela gore yo mongwe le yo mongwe a ka ba le kankere ya KS, goba ba ikwa gore ba kotsing ya kankere ya KS.
Amharic: ተሳታፊዎቹ ከሚዲያ ከማየታቸው በፊት ስለ ካ.ሳ ቁስሎች በትክክል ያውቁ የነበሩት እና ሁሉም ሰው ካ.ሳን ሊያዳብር ወይም በካ.ሳ አደጋ ውስጥ ሊሆን እንደሚችል የሚሰማቸው ሰዎች በጣም ጥቂት እንደነበሩ ዘግበዋል፡፡

Source: However, after exposure, more people could now correctly identify KS wounds, felt they were at risk of KS and believed that anyone could develop KS.
Luganda: Wabula, oluvannyuma lw’okulaba obutambi, abantu bangi abaali basobola okuzuula ebiwundu bya KS mu butuufu, abaawulira nti bali mu katyabaga ka KS era abakkiriza nti omuntu yenna asobola okufuna KS.
Yoruba: Ṣùgbọ́n, lẹ́yìn ìlàlọ́yẹ̀, ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn èèyàn ló lè ṣe ìdámọ̀ egbò KS dáadáa, ní ìmọ̀lára pé wọ́n wà nínú ewu à ti kó KS, àti wí pé wọ́n gbàgbọ́ pé ẹnikẹ́ni ló lè ni KS.
Zulu: Kodwa-ke, ngemva kokuvela obala, abantu abaningi manje sebengakwazi ukubona amanxeba e-KS ngendlela efanele, bazizwa besengozini ye-KS futhi bakholelwa ukuthi noma ubani angaba ne-KS.
Hausa: Ko ta yaya, bayan bayyanawa, ƙarin mutane yanzu suna iya gano raunukan KS daidai, suna jin suna cikin haɗarin KS kuma sun yi imanin cewa kowa zai iya haɓaka KS.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale, ka morago ga go fihlelela melaetša ye, batho ba bantši bjale ba be ba kgona go hlatha kankere ya KS ka fao go nepagetšego, ba ikwa gore ba kotsing ya kankere ya KS le go dumela gore motho ofe goba ofe a ka ba le kankere ya KS.
Amharic: ከትውውቁ በኋላ ግን ብዙ ሰዎች የካ.ሳን ቁስሎች በትክክል ለይተው ያወቁ ሲሆን ለካ.ሳ አደጋ ተጋላጭ እንደሆኑ ተሰምቷቸዋል፤ እንዲሁም ማንኛውም ሰው ካ.ሳ ሊያዳብር እንደሚችል አምነዋል፡፡

Source: Numbers of those who knew that doctors needed to test part of their skin to confirm if they had the disease also increased after watching the cartoons.
Luganda: Emiwendo gy’abo abaali bamanyi nti abasawo baali beetaaga okukebera ekitundu ky’olususu lwabwe okukakasa oba nga baalina endwadde era yeeyongera oluvannyuma lw’okulaba katuuni.
Yoruba: Iye àwọn tó mọ̀ pé dókítà nílò láti ṣe àyèwò ẹ̀yà ara wọn kí ó lè mọ̀ bóyá wọ́n ní àrùn yìí pò si lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n wo àwọn àwòrán ẹ̀fẹ̀.
Zulu: Izibalo zalabo abazi ukuthi odokotela kudingeka bahlole ingxenye yesikhumba sabo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi banaso yini lesi sifo zanda ngemuva kokubuka opopayi.
Hausa: Adadin waɗanda suka san cewa likitoci na buƙatar su gwada wani ɓangare na fatar jikinsu don tabbatar da ko suna ɗauke da cutar kuma sun ƙaru bayan kallon zane-zanen.
Northern Sotho: Dipalo tša bao ba tsebago gore dingaka di nyaka go dira diteko go dikarolo tša letlalo la bona ge ba na le bolwetši bjo di ile tša oketšega ka morago ga go bogela dikhathune.
Amharic: በበሽታው መያዛቸውን ለማረጋገጥ የቆዳቸውን ክፍል ለመመርመር ዶክተሮች እንደሚያስፈልጓቸው የሚያውቁ ሰዎች ቁጥርም የካርቱን ፊልሙን ከተመለከቱ በኋላ ጨምሯል፡፡

Source: Researchers observed that after exposure to media, 37% more respondents said they would now go to a hospital or clinic to do the skin test.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakiraba nti oluvannyuma lw’okulaba obutambi, abeetabi abalala abakola ebitundu 37% baagamba nti mu kiseera ekyo baali basobola okugenda mu ddwaliro oba akalwaliro okwekebeza olususu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí wòye pé lẹ́yìn ìlà lọ́yẹ sí àwọn ẹ̀rọ oníròyìn, 37% àwọn adáhùn-ìbéèrè ní àwọn máa lọ sí ilé-ìwòsàn tàbí ilé-ìtọ́jú láti ṣe àyèwò ara.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baqaphele ukuthi ngemva kokuvela obala kwabemithombo yabezindaba, abanye abangama-37% abaphendula bathi manje bazoya esibhedlela noma emtholampilo ukuze bayohlola isikhumba.
Hausa: Masu bincike sun lura cewa bayan bayyanar da midiya, kashi 37% na ƙarin masu amsaws sun ce yanzu za su je asibiti ko ƙaramin asibiti don yin gwajin fata.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba bona gore ka morago ga go fihlelela melaetša ya kgašo, 37% ya baarabi ba bangwe ba boletše gore bjale ba tla ya sepetlele goba kliniking go dira teko ya letlalo.
Amharic: 37% ተጨማሪ ምላሽ ሰጪዎች ሚዲያ ካዩ በኋላ አሁን ላይ ወደ ሆስፒታል ወይም ክሊኒክ ሄደው የቆዳ ምርመራ እንደሚያደርጉ ተመራማሪዎቹ አስተውለዋል፡፡

Source: However, even after exposure to the media, many participants still did not know what caused KS.
Luganda: Wabula, wadde nga bamaze okulaba obutambi, abeetabi bangi era baasigala tebamanyi kintu ekyali kiviirako KS.
Yoruba: Síbẹ̀-síbẹ̀, lẹ́yìn ìlà lọ́yẹ nípa ẹ̀rọ oníròyìn, ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn akópa ni kò mọ ohun tí ó ṣokùnfa KS.
Zulu: Kodwa-ke, ngisho nangemva kokuvezwa kwabemithombo yabezindaba, ababambiqhaza abaningi bebengazi ukuthi yini eyabangela i-KS.
Hausa: Duk da haka, ko da bayan bayyana ga midiya, yawancin mahalarta har yanzu ba su san abin da ya haifar da KS ba.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale, ka morago ga go fihlelela melaetša ya kgašo, bakgathatema ba bantši le bjale ba be ba sa tsebe gore ke ng seo se bakago kankare ya KS.
Amharic: ነገር ግን ለሚዲያ ከተዋወቁ በኋላ አንኳ ብዙ ተሳታፊዎች የካ.ሳ መንስኤ ምን እንደሆነ አያውቁም ነበር፡፡

Source: Results also showed that participants in urban areas were more likely to correctly identify KS from pictures compared to those in rural areas.
Luganda: Ebyazuulibwa era byalaga nti abeetabi mu bitundu by’ekibuga baalina emikisa mingi okuzuula KS mu bifaananyi okusinga ku abo ab’omu byalo.
Yoruba: Èsì mìíràn fihàn pé ó ṣeé ṣe kí àwọn akópa tó wà ni ìgboro dá KS mọ̀ daádáa láti inú àwòrán ju àwọn tó wà nínú abúlé lọ.
Zulu: Imiphumela iphinde yabonisa ukuthi ababambiqhaza ezindaweni zasemadolobheni maningi amathuba okuthi bahlonze i-KS ezithombeni uma kuqhathaniswa nalabo abasezindaweni zasemakhaya.
Hausa: Haka nan kuma sakamakon ya kuma nuna cewa mahalarta a cikin birane sun fi iya gane KS daidai daga hotuna idan aka kwatanta da na yankunan karkara.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo di laeditše gape gore bakgathatema ba ka mafelong a ditoropong go be go na le kgonagalo ye ntši ya gore ba ka tseba kankere ya KS go diswantšho ge go bapetšwa le ba ka mafelong a dinagamagaeng.
Amharic: ውጤቶቹ እንደሚያሳዩት፣ በከተማ ውስጥ ያሉ ተሳታፊዎች በገጠር ካሉት ጋር ሲነጻጸሩ ካ.ሳን በትክክል ከስእሎች ላይ ለይተው የማውጣት አዝማሚያቸው ከፍተኛ ነበር፡፡

Source: Then the researchers asked participants about risk factors, only 1 in 5 felt that all people were at risk; 16% believed that KS could be passed from one person to another; and about 1 in 10 felt the poor are at more at risk or that being sexually active puts one at risk.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bwe baabuuza abeetabi ebikwata ku katyabaga k’okufuna endwadde, omuntu 1 mu 5 eyawulira ng’abantu bonna baali mu katyabaga; abantu abakola ebitundu 16% be bakkiriza nti KS asobola okusaasaana okuva ku muntu omu okudda ku mulala; ate era omuntu 1 mu bantu 10 ye yawulira nti abaavu balina akatyabaga ka maanyi oba eky’okuba ng’omuntu yeegatta mu mukwano kimuteeka mu katyabaga.
Yoruba: Nígbà tí àwọn aṣèwádìí bèrè awọn ewu tó rọ̀ mọ́ ọn lọ́wọ́ àwọn akópa, 1 sí 5 péré ni wọ́n ni ìmọ̀lára gbogbo ènìyàn ni ó wà nínú ewu àti kó o, 16% gbàgbọ́ pé èèyàn lè kó KS láti ara èèyàn kan sí òmíràn; nígbà tí 1 sí 10 ní ìmọ̀lára pé àwọn tálákà wà nínú ewu tó pọ̀ láti kó o tàbí pé ìbálòpò máa ń fi èèyàn sínú ewu à ti kó o.
Zulu: Lapho abacwaningi bebuza ababambiqhaza ngezici eziyingozi, o-1 kuphela kwabayi-5 waba nomuzwa wokuthi bonke abantu basengozini; I-16% yayikholelwa ukuthi i-KS ingadluliselwa komunye umuntu; futhi cishe o-1 kwabayi-10 waba nomuzwa wokuthi abampofu basengozini enkulu noma ukuthi ukuya ocansini kubeka umuntu engozini.
Hausa: Lokacin da masu binciken suka tambayi mahalarta game da abubuwan haɗari, kawai 1 a cikin 5 sun ji cewa duk mutane suna cikin haɗari; 16% sun yi imani cewa KS za a iya wucewa daga mutum ɗaya zuwa wani; kuma kusan 1 cikin 10 suna jin cewa matalauta sun fi fuskantar haɗari ko kuma yin jima'i yana jefa mutum cikin haɗari.
Northern Sotho: Ge banyakišiši ba botšiša bakgathatema ka ga dikotsi, ke fela o 1 go ba 5 bao ba ilego ba ikwa gore batho ka moka ba be ba le kotsing; 16% e dumetše gore kankere ya KS e ka fetišwa go tloga go motho go ya go yo mongwe; gomme yo a ka bago o 1 go ba 10 ba ile ba ikwa gore bahloki ba kotsing ye kgolo goba gore go tsenela tša thobalano kudu go bea motho kotsing.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች ስለ አደጋው ምክንያት ተሳታፊዎቹን ሲጠይቋቸው ከ5ቱ ውስጥ 1ዱ ብቻ ነበር ሁሉም ሰው ለአደጋው ተጋላጭ እንደሆን የተሰማው፤16% ያህሉ ካ.ሳ ከአንድ ሰው ወደሌላው ሰው ሊተላለፍ እንደሚችል ያምናሉ፤ እንዲሁም ከ10 ሰዎች 1ዱ ድህነት ወይም የግብረ ስጋ ግንኙነት ማድረጉ አንድን ሰው የበለጠ ተጋላጭ እንደሚያደርገው ተሰምቶታል፡፡

Source: Most (60%) said they would go immediately to a hospital or clinic if they developed suspicious wounds.
Luganda: Abasinga obungi (ebitundu 60%) baagamba nti bajja kugenda mangu mu ddwaliro oba akalwaliro singa bafuna ebiwundu ebiriko akabuuza.
Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀ (60%) sọ pé àwọn máa lo sí ilé-ìwòsàn ní kíákíá tàbí ilé-ìtójú tí àwọn ba ní egbò tó mú ìfura dání.
Zulu: Iningi (60%) lathi liya ngokushesha esibhedlela noma emtholampilo uma liba namanxeba asolisayo.
Hausa: Yawancin (60%) sun ce za su je asibiti ko ƙaramin asibiti nan-da-nan idan sun sami raunuka da suke zargi.
Northern Sotho: Ba bantši (60%) ba boletše gore ba tla ya sepetlele goba kliniki ka pela ge ba ka ba le dintho tša go belaetša.
Amharic: አብዛኛዎቹ (60%) አጠራጣሪ ቁስል ካዳበሩ ወዲያውኑ ወደ ሆስፒታል ወይም ወደ ክሊኒክ እንደሚሄዱ ተናግረዋል፡፡

Source: The researchers said almost all participants (96%) found the media relevant to their culture, and were happy (93%) with the media content.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti kyenkana abeetabi bonna (ebitundu 96%) baalaba ng’obutambi butuukana n’obuwangwa bwabwe, era nga baasanyukira (ebitundu 93%) obubaka obuli mu butambi.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé púpọ̀ nínú àwọn akópa (96%) rí ẹ̀rọ oníròyìn gẹ́gẹ́ bí ohun tí ó jọjú sí àṣà wọn, à ti wí pé inú wọ̀n dùn (93%) ní àwọn àkóónú ẹ̀rọ oníròyìn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi cishe bonke ababambiqhaza (96%) bathole abemithombo yabezindaba behambisana nesiko labo, futhi bajabule (93%) ngokuqukethwe imithombo yabezindaba.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce kusan dukkanin mahalarta (96%) sun sami kafofin watsa labaru masu dacewa da al'adunsu, kuma sun yi farin ciki (93%) tare da abubuwan da suke cikin midiya ɗin.
